What a .hive file actually is (plain English)
A .hive file is not something you created manually and not a document you were meant to read.
It is a database file used by the Finch self-care app (the app with the bird).
Finch is built on Flutter, and it uses a local database system called Hive.
So:

.hive = app’s internal data storage
Think: “Finch’s save files”

It’s the same idea as:

a game save file
